anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet, J4 (USB_A) pin 3 (D+) and pin 2 (D-) both carry the global label NET0044, and J11 (Barrel_Jack_Switch) pin 1 (center, positive) also carries NET0044.
anomalies.expected: USB D+ and D- must be two separate nets routed to the SKW92A USB pins (U2.18/U2.19); the barrel-jack center should connect only to the BAT+ power rail.

evidence.quote: J4 USB_A: 3 D+ -> NET0044; 2 D- -> NET0044 (EthernetAndPower sheet)

anomalies.impact: USB D+ and D- are shorted together and to the power input, so USB data communication cannot work and the data pins are tied to the battery/USB rail.

anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, J3 pins 10 and 11 both carry the global label NET0010; on the SkylabModule sheet, U2 pins 42 and 43 also both carry NET0010.
anomalies.expected: The EPD control signals (RST_N, DC, BUSY_N, CSB, SCL, SDA) are six distinct nets; adjacent pins must not share a net.

evidence.quote: J3 pins 9-14: NET0014, NET0010, NET0010, NET0011, NET0078, NET0028 (EPD_Driver sheet)
J1.10 (RST_N) <-> EINK_DISPLAY_RESET <-> U5.44; J1.11 (DC) <-> EINK_DATA_COMMAND <-> U5.42

anomalies.impact: Two EPD control lines are shorted, so the display cannot be driven correctly (e.g. reset and data/command are tied together).

parsed.summary: The schematic contains net-bridging anomalies: the USB D+/D- lines (and the barrel-jack center) all share NET0044, and two adjacent EPD control lines share NET0010. Both would prevent the intended USB and display interfaces from working.
